Headquartered in Essen, Germany, we have more than 18,100 employees worldwide and operate a network of around 600 sites in more than 70 countries. The two global divisions, Brenntag Essentials and Brenntag Specialties, provide a diversified and broad portfolio of industrial and specialty chemicals and ingredients as well as tailor-made application, marketing and supply chain solutions, technical and formulation support, comprehensive regulatory know-how and digital solutions for a wide range of industries. Brenntag pursues an ambitious sustainability agenda and is committed to sustainable solutions in its own sector and the industries served. Brenntag SE shares have been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2010 and have been part of the DAX since September 2021. In addition, the Brenntag SE shares are listed in the DAX 30 ESG and DAX ESG Target.

# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

## Solutions that go beyond distribution 

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step.

## Rooted in local teams, connected across the globe 

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs.

and ensuring local markets have access to the high-quality materials they deserve.

development by supplying essential chemicals to the markets that need them most.**

Proudly extending our sales to over 50 countries, we are committed to being the reliable partner for
our customers, offering global reach with local insights. In a challenging marketplace, REDA
Chemicals stands as your partner in advancing industrial capabilities efficiently and effectively.

[Read More][27]

Integrity BioChem’s unique biopolymers are plant-based – derived from naturally occurring, renewable
resources.

non-renewable resources.

reused, or recycled for other applications and products–allowing you to decrease your footprint by
